donor_texts: The spectral analysis reveals four transport species across transformer architectures. GQA ratio predicts species classification with high accuracy. Tunnel models show fixed-point convergence, relay models show monotonic drift, sorter models oscillate, and absorber models show chaotic dynamics. The therapeutic window at doses D2-D3 appears substrate-independent.

Spectral analysis identifies four transport species in transformer architectures. GQA ratio accurately predicts these species. Tunnel models converge, relay models exhibit monotonic drift, sorter models oscillate, and absorber models display chaotic behavior. At doses D2-D3, the therapeutic window is substrate-independent.
